title: Apply Universal Capability Access to the full FA3 donor registry
decision: Apply the Universal Capability Access rule retroactively to every current donor record and prospectively to every future donor record.
A donor-imposed geographic, territorial, noncommercial, account, cloud, platform or hardware restriction must never become the sole implementation path of an FA3 user-facing capability.
Keep restricted donors as references when useful, but require a globally usable FA3-native or independently rights-cleared substitute before restricted material adoption.
Do not evade upstream restrictions with VPN, proxying, foreign hosting, artifact relocation or equivalent circumvention.
Unknown or unverified access rights fail closed for material adoption.
Preserve the existing License & Rights Authority, Donor Registry, Model Router, HRB and other canonical authorities; create no parallel authority.
